name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Clean up the 'Editing Station' toolbar layout: split the single crowded row of eleven controls and a raw file input into three groups (identity + navigation/save at top, a labeled 'Station Operations' row, a labeled 'Station Artwork' row). Restyled the artwork file picker as a proper button with a live-updating chosen-filename label instead of the unstyled native file input that was truncating its own text.

Fix chat_preview AJAX regression: the 3.0.8 action->afm_action rename updated every button but missed runChatPreviewAjax()'s manually-constructed FormData, which still hardcoded the old field name (formData.set('action', 'chat_preview')). Chat Preview has been silently broken since 3.0.8. Fixed, and added regression tests since this path had zero prior coverage.
